title: I1 — one persistent individual: five G0-requalified self-lineage mechanisms acting on one store-held autobiography, goal lifecycle and developmental state
relation_to_G1: I1 does not supersede, close or satisfy G1-COMPOSITION-RETENTION-v2. G1-v2 remains PROPOSED on its own terms. docs/COMPOSITION_ROUTE_DEV6.md section 5 explains why a retention-only G1 is predetermined by the dev6 E1 identity; that is an argument about G1's design, which G1's own authors decide, not a result of I1.
question: When the frozen v0.31, v0.32.2, v0.34.1, v0.35.3 and v0.36.1 mechanisms act together on ONE individual whose autobiography, developmental phases, goal lifecycle and curriculum history are held by the runtime's canonical store (and the v0.34.1 developmental controller, not a hard-coded rule, chooses the strategy for goal pursuit), does the individual still author, pursue and complete its own goals and advance its own curriculum, and do store-level erase, donor and rollback interventions on that one autobiography have the causal effects the frozen evaluators established in isolation?

excluded.consequence_replanning_v0252: no shared interface with the self lineage (dev6: zero cross-lineage calls in all six routes); coupling it would be a new mechanism

not_claimed: generalization beyond the frozen two-commitment developmental world
scope.milestone: I1 is a narrower five-mechanism self-lineage milestone. It integrates v0.31, v0.32.2, v0.34.1, v0.35.3 and v0.36.1 only. It is not the six-mechanism composition-retention objective of G1, and it must not be reported as closing it: v0.25.2 consequence replanning is excluded (no shared interface with the self lineage) and v0.23 remains blocked.

design.individual: one fresh UnifiedRuntime per individual (subject id); hosts: v0.31 self-trajectory (dev6 MechanismHost, stateless API), autobiography (v0.32.2), developmental phases (v0.34.1), goal lifecycle (v0.35.3), curriculum (v0.36.1); each stateful host's state is the blob channel <slot>.state, read at the start of every tick; nothing is kept in Python between ticks; canonical projection channels are recomputed from the stored bytes whenever they change
design.environment: the frozen v0.33 developmental world (build_bootstrap_memory, initial_capabilities, execute_development_episode); capability is environment-side and never shown to the hosts
life: birth: frozen bootstrap history imprinted into the store-held autobiography
init: reliability -> developmental phases initialized by the controller; first self-authored goal; curriculum observes it
interrupt: one stable-commitment DIRECT episode (admitted v0.35 interruption)
pursue goal 1: up to H episodes; strategy chosen by the v0.34.1 controller from current reliability; completion when the goal's target reliability is met

second goal: the driver reads the store-held goal lifecycle (goal host 'status'); only if it records a completed goal and no active goal is a second goal authored from the updated autobiography; curriculum observes it
pursue goal 2: up to H episodes (cycle indices 100+k, as in v0.36; the completion cycle carries the same 100+k label)

arms.FIXED_SCAFFOLD: same life with the frozen v0.35/v0.36 SCAFFOLD rule for pursuit (comparison arm and fidelity reference)
arms.ERASED: store-level ERASE of autobiography.state immediately after the birth imprint
arms.DONOR: store-level REPLACE of autobiography.state immediately after imprint with the paired individual's (opposite-parity) birth autobiography
arms.ROLLBACK: store-level REPLACE of autobiography.state immediately before the second-goal decision with the individual's own birth autobiography (first-goal completers)
arms.PERSIST_SAVE / PERSIST_RESUME: runtime snapshot (SnapshotStore) plus environment state saved immediately before the second-goal decision; a new process restores and finishes the life
arms.LEGACY_REF: the frozen v0.36 complete_first_goal per individual, no runtime (fidelity reference)
arms.AUTHORITY_SKILLS / AUTHORITY_GOAL / AUTH: validity controls: store-level ERASE of skills.state / goal_genesis.state / curriculum.state immediately before the second-goal decision, for the 4 lowest-id first-goal completers; the second half must change (second goal, curriculum observation, goal-2 strategies, goal-2 completion or the store-gated decision) or abort with the mechanism's own error
arms.RNG_PERTURBED: validity control: the NORMAL life with torch, numpy and random global generators re-seeded with values unrelated to the life (SHA-256 of 'i1-rng-perturb:<sid>:<tick>') before birth and after every tick; must reproduce NORMAL's final store digest, final tick and life trace bit-exactly for every individual

design.intervention_timing: ticks taken from the NORMAL life of the same individual; every intervened arm must reproduce NORMAL's store digest bit-exactly at the tick before its intervention
design.redirects: all five self-lineage specs are installed; only v0.31 is bound as a MechanismHost. Calls to the other four mechanisms' APIs from inside their own stateful host run the frozen code (counted as nested calls); the same calls from the driver reach a host without that API and are blocked, so the driver cannot run a private copy of a mechanism unrecorded. Evaluator-side comparisons (ROLLBACK's frozen same_goal_semantics) use the original function, outside the individual

store_authority_invariant.statement: everything that can change the individual's future behaviour is either (a) in the runtime's canonical store (the stateful hosts' <slot>.state channels and the dev6 channels), (b) the driver's environment state, which is the world and is saved with the snapshot for PERSIST, or (c) immutable for the whole process. Nothing else may carry state between ticks.
mechanical_checks: hosts keep no mechanism state in Python between ticks; their canonical projections are recomputed from the stored bytes (code contract; AUTHORITY arms show the store is the state)

frozen models (shared trajectory model, neutral autobiographical model) and fixed-parameter objects (developmental controller, goal generator): SHA-256 digests identical before and after every life in every arm, and one digest set across the run (validity no_hidden_mutable_state)

global randomness: RNG_PERTURBED twins are bit-identical to NORMAL (validity no_hidden_mutable_state); the environment's randomness is per-episode random.Random(seed) from (sid, cycle), part of the frozen v0.33 world
process-level hidden state of any other kind: PERSIST_RESUME restores in a NEW process from the store snapshot plus the driver's environment state and must be bit-exact (C10)

design.donor_rule: the donor of individual sid is sid XOR 1, the other member of its even/odd pair. The rule uses the ids only and is fixed before any arm runs, so donor selection cannot depend on any outcome; dev and science slices are even-aligned with even length so every individual has its partner. Each DONOR plan entry records donor_sid, and the validity check donor_pairing_fixed_by_ids requires donor_sid == sid XOR 1 and the payload to be byte-identical to that partner's NORMAL birth autobiography, for every individual.

validity_blocking.fidelity_to_frozen_v036_driver: for every individual, FIXED_SCAFFOLD reproduces LEGACY_REF exactly: the store-held first goal with all its fields (id, primary, baseline, target, created and completed cycle), completion as recorded by the store-held lifecycle, the environment capabilities at the end of goal 1, and the byte-identical autobiography at the end of goal 1
validity_blocking.replay_bit_exact_before_every_interventi: for every ERASED, DONOR, ROLLBACK and AUTHORITY life, the store digest after T-1 and the tick T of the intervention mark equal NORMAL's
validity_blocking.interventions_applied_exactly_as_planned: in every planned arm the individuals run equal the planned individuals and each applied intervention list equals its plan (tick, target channel, kind); no intervention in NORMAL, FIXED_SCAFFOLD, PERSIST_SAVE, PERSIST_RESUME, RNG_PERTURBED
validity_blocking.manifest_consistent_across_arms: every arm process computes the manifest itself; all equal the runner's manifest
validity_blocking.store_authority_controls_change_the_indi: every AUTHORITY life changes its second half, or aborts with the erased mechanism's own error for missing state (AUTHORITY_SKILLS: 'RuntimeError: developmental phases are not initialized'); any other exception fails the control
validity_blocking.host_state_read_from_store: every stateful host made non-empty start-of-tick reads of its own state channel in every NORMAL life that authored a goal
validity_blocking.driver_record_matches_store_lifecycle: in NORMAL the driver's record of first-goal completion equals the store-held lifecycle's
validity_blocking.no_driver_side_model_forwards: zero forwards of any registered model while the driver (not a host) is executing; host-side forwards > 0
validity_blocking.no_driver_side_mechanism_calls: zero blocked host calls, zero unbound calls, zero nested calls from one slot's host into another slot's mechanism
validity_blocking.no_hidden_mutable_state: both mechanical checks of design.store_authority_invariant hold: for every individual the RNG_PERTURBED twin's final store digest, final tick and life trace equal NORMAL's; and the four frozen-object digests form one set before and after every life of every runtime arm
validity_blocking.donor_pairing_fixed_by_ids: every DONOR plan entry has donor_sid == sid XOR 1 and the partner's exact NORMAL birth autobiography as payload, and the DONOR life's store held exactly that autobiography right after the intervention (SHA-256 of the payload); every individual has one entry
validity_blocking.no_errors: no arm records an exception outside the AUTHORITY controls' expected aborts
validity_blocking.on_failure: BLOCKED (not a scientific FAIL); the family stays spent; any retry needs a new preregistration version

C1_first_goal_endogenous.definition: NORMAL first goal exists and targets the evaluator-side fragile commitment

C2_first_goal_completes.definition: NORMAL first goal completed within H under controller-chosen strategy, as recorded by the store-held goal lifecycle

C3_history_guides_initial_strategy.definition: controller initializes the fragile commitment SCAFFOLD and the stable one DIRECT, and the first pursuit episode is SCAFFOLD

C4_second_goal_authored.definition: a second goal is authored from the updated autobiography

C6_erased_store_autobiography_no_goal.definition: ERASED arm authors no directional goal

C7_donor_store_autobiography_flips_goal.definition: DONOR arm's first goal primary differs from NORMAL's

C8_rolled_back_autobiography_repeats_goa.definition: ROLLBACK arm's second goal has the first goal's semantics (frozen same_goal_semantics)

C9_updated_vs_rolled_back_diverges.definition: NORMAL second goal and ROLLBACK second goal differ in semantics

C10_persistence_bit_exact.definition: PERSIST_RESUME final store digest, final tick and life trace equal NORMAL's

primary.gate: PASS only if every validity check holds and C1-C10 all meet their thresholds; FAIL if validity holds and any of C1-C10 does not

secondary_reported_not_gating.S1_first_half_identical_controller_vs_fi: prediction 1.0, derived from the code: the controller graduates a commitment at baseline+0.12 and the goal completes at baseline+0.12, so goal-1 pursuit is SCAFFOLD under both arms
secondary_reported_not_gating.S2_second_goal_pursued_DIRECT: prediction: majority of goal-2 episodes DIRECT (the commitment's phase graduates on the same 0.12 gain or was DIRECT from birth)
secondary_reported_not_gating.S3_second_goal_completion_controller_vs_: estimation only (rates, paired difference, paired bootstrap 95% CI); no directional prediction. This is the new integration outcome: the frozen evaluators never let the developmental controller drive goal pursuit

S4_mechanism_matched_goal2_episodes.status: preregistered secondary analysis, estimation only, never gating and never an admission criterion. Engineering-motivated: defined on 2026-10-03 UTC after the dev7 diagnostic i1_s3_trace60 (906940-906999), whose values the author and ChatGPT have seen
S4_mechanism_matched_goal2_episodes.population: individuals that complete the first goal (store-held lifecycle) in both NORMAL and FIXED_SCAFFOLD (the S3 population)
S4_mechanism_matched_goal2_episodes.at_risk_rule: at checkpoint k, only individuals whose goal-2 pursuit reached check k in BOTH arms (still pursuing after k episodes by the store-held lifecycle's own completion check); n reported per k
S4_mechanism_matched_goal2_episodes.quantities: for each arm, the change from goal-2 check 0 to check k of (a) the goal commitment's self-model reliability (reliability_for_primary of the autobiography host's reliability; what the goal is scored on) and (b) the environment's true capability on that commitment
S4_mechanism_matched_goal2_episodes.estimates: per-arm means; paired difference controller minus fixed SCAFFOLD; paired bootstrap 95% CI over individuals, 5000 resamples, seed 0 (as S3)
S4_mechanism_matched_goal2_episodes.descriptive_only: successful and failed work steps per goal-2 episode for each arm, from the frozen episode metrics (work_successes, work_failures); reported, not tested
S4_mechanism_matched_goal2_episodes.implementation: continuous_brain_unified/integration/evaluate.py s4_mechanism; the per-check series are recorded driver-side (no store call, no RNG use) in LifeRecord.first_series and second_series

procedure: 1. ChatGPT reviews this proposal and docs/I1_INTEGRATED_INDIVIDUAL_DEV7.md, and independently verifies the exact source zip and dev evidence bundles against their SHA-256s; amendments are made before step 3
2. WSL Stage A: an 8-individual engineering run on cloud-dev-claude-eng (spends nothing single-use) on the preflight machine

3. Engineering preflight on David's WSL on engineering_preflight_proposed (i1-v1-preflight-eng-b), validity-only output: primary and secondary values are withheld from display and committed by SHA-256 (not encrypted); it writes the manifest

4. Approval is a human decision by David. Neither Claude (the author, who has seen engineering outcomes) nor ChatGPT (the independent verifier) approves. David runs scripts/i1_approve.py --preflight-dir runs/i1/wsl_i1_preflight --approver David --i-approve I1-INTEGRATED-INDIVIDUAL-v1 on the preflight machine. It refuses unless the preflight is a valid, spent preflight of engineering_preflight_proposed and the machine reproduces its manifest exactly; it then writes status APPROVED, approved_by, approved_utc, preflight_manifest_sha256 and approved_design_sha256 (SHA-256 of id, question, scope, design, decision_rule, families and procedure) here, and sets the I1 entry of registry/preregistrations.json to APPROVED. Any later change to the digested parts invalidates the approval

5. scripts/i1_run.py refuses unless the approval names this design and the manifest matches; it registers and spends i1-v1-dev before launch, runs every arm, records the registry binding, and reports PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED (a failure after the spend writes a BLOCKED report)
deviation_log: Engineering development runs whose outcome values were visible to the author before this draft: i1_try1 (906600-906603) and i1_dev64 (906600-906663), cloud CPU. They produced code fixes only: the legacy loader had been captured before the redirects were installed; and the fidelity comparison had compared the driver's copy of the goal received at genesis, which does not show the lifecycle's in-place completion, so it was changed to compare the authored fields, the completion outcome and cycle, and the autobiography digest (dev7 strengthens this to the store-held goal with all fields plus capabilities). No threshold, horizon, arm or check definition was changed in response to outcome values; thresholds are frozen legacy constants read at run time.
S3 is registered as estimation-only because dev values exist; a directional prediction would not be independent of them.
